identity.notes: Cranes Spanish Kaiseki at 724 9th Street NW permanently closed on February 18, 2026. Chef-owner Pepe Moncayo confirmed the closure to Eater. Fresh inspection shows the official website account expired, the exact Toast storefront has no menu items, and Uber Eats reports the restaurant closed since February 10, 2026. Stale vendor hours do not outweigh the confirmed closure.
